classification.family:
Contra **hh:s:Rix:Etruscan:2008**, **hh:hv:Rix:Ratisch** it is advisable to take
a more cautious position with respect to the genealogical relatedness of
Rhaetian with Etruscan **hh:hvld:Marchesini:Italia-Antica**:59. We wish to thank
Raoul Zamponi for clarifying the status of Rhaetian to us.

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: A number of ancient European and Ancient Near Eastern languages are not listed in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. One of them is Etruscan (**hh:g:Wallace:Etruscan**).
